text: again bump to v1 1 this time, we changed the cover
tell me which format lost the fonts on export
drop in a pdf export preset: tagged, outlines off, images 300
set pdf preset tagged fonts embedded
line the three exports up in the delivery folder
instead of one folder split by recipient
show what changed in the delivery folder
next email the docx to Priya and keep the pdf for the board
set delivery Priya docx board pdf
I wonder if the epub passed the checker, run it again
make the epub check part of the export, every time
thanks, shipping is one click now!
have the invoice table compute the vat line automatically
set invoice vat 20 percent computed
can you total the columns at the bottom in bold
then carry the total to the summary box at the top
set summary box total bold large
again round the total this time, whole numbers only
tell me which line items lack a code
drop in a payment terms line under the table: net 30
set payment terms net 30 small
line the amounts up right aligned with the currency symbol consistent
instead of trailing symbol put it before, this is not a menu
show what changed to the invoice
next duplicate the invoice as a template with blanks
set invoice template blanks no totals
please make the columns of the invoice template match the sample
I wonder if the logo should sit left or centered
make the logo left, quieter, same gray as the footer
thanks, invoicing looks grown up!
that would help getting paid.
merge the two source docs into one report, keep the better intro
set merge prefer doc one intro
can you deduplicate the references after the merge
then renumber the citations in the merged text
set citations renumber sequential
again keep author date, no renumber this time
tell me how many duplicates the merge created
highest first: list the duplicated passages by length
line the merged sections up in one consistent voice
instead of my voice aim for the style guide voice
show what changed after the merge
next run a consistency pass on units, metric everywhere
set units metric consistent
please make the columns of the merged tables share one header style
I wonder if either source had a hidden section
make the hidden sections visible, then delete them with my approval
thanks, one document from two histories!
where is the preface supposed to sit? before the TOC feels right
can you move the preface after the cover but before everything else
set preface order cover then preface
then date the preface with month and year only
set preface dated month year city optional
again no city this time, it felt presumptuous
tell me who the acknowledgments currently thank
drop in a line thanking the pilot readers by group
set acknowledgments pilot readers group anonymous
line the acknowledgments up as one flowing paragraph
instead of one paragraph use short stanzas per group
show what changed to the front matter again
next keep the acknowledgments to one page maximum
set acknowledgments one page max
please make the columns of the dedication centered by eye
I wonder if a preface and an intro are redundant here
make the preface personal, the intro technical, clear split
thanks, front matter earns its pages at last!
put a drop cap on the first paragraph of each chapter
set drop cap two lines serif plain
can you make the drop cap sit flush with the margin
then color it the same ink as the chapter number
set drop cap ink match chapter number
again plain black this time, calmer
tell me which chapters already had a drop cap
drop in a fleuron between sections instead of white space
set fleuron small centered asterisk trio
line the section separators up consistently across chapters
instead of fleurons use a thin rule in one chapter only
show what changed to the openings
next add a small ornament under the part titles
set part ornament small rule flourish
please make the columns of the ornamental bits consistent, they vary
I wonder if ornaments are too victorian for this guide
make the ornaments geometric, simple squares
thanks, openings are dressed but not costumed!
that would help the browse test.
can you check every hyperlink still resolves after the reshuffle
then list the broken ones by section
set hyperlink check report broken only
again include the external links this time
tell me which external links died since March
drop in a qr code on the back page linking the survey
set qr code back page 2 cm margin 2
line the qr code up centered under the closing text
instead of the back page put it inside the back cover flap
show what changed to the ending pages
next shorten the closing text to two sentences
set closing text two sentences max
I wonder if the survey promise is too pushy
make the ask gentle, one line under the code
thanks, links all accounted for!
